model: iQ500 fully integrated dishwasher (exact model not readable)
goal_native: Run a normal everyday wash with the Eco 50° programme
goal_en: Run a normal everyday wash with the Eco 50° programme
intro_native: This is a Siemens built-in dishwasher, most likely from the iQ500 range. The buttons are on the top edge of the door. Let's run a normal everyday wash together.
intro_en: This is a Siemens built-in dishwasher, most likely from the iQ500 range. The buttons are on the top edge of the door. Let's run a normal everyday wash together.

buttons.function_native: Switches the dishwasher on or off. During a wash it pauses the programme.
buttons.function_en: Switches the dishwasher on or off. During a wash it pauses the programme.

buttons.function_native: For pots, pans and sturdy items with burnt-on or dried-on food.
buttons.function_en: For pots, pans and sturdy items with burnt-on or dried-on food.

buttons.function_native: For mixed loads. A sensor checks how dirty the water is and adjusts the wash.
buttons.function_en: For mixed loads. A sensor checks how dirty the water is and adjusts the wash.

buttons.function_native: The most economical programme for normally dirty dishes. It runs long on purpose to save energy.
buttons.function_en: The most economical programme for normally dirty dishes. It runs long on purpose to save energy.

buttons.function_native: A quiet programme for mixed loads, for example at night.
buttons.function_en: A quiet programme for mixed loads, for example at night.

buttons.function_native: A gentle wash for delicate glasses and heat-sensitive items.
buttons.function_en: A gentle wash for delicate glasses and heat-sensitive items.

buttons.function_native: Washes a normally dirty load in about one hour.
buttons.function_en: Washes a normally dirty load in about one hour.

buttons.function_native: A short wash for lightly dirty dishes. It does not dry them.
buttons.function_en: A short wash for lightly dirty dishes. It does not dry them.

buttons.function_native: A short press rinses a part load. Holding it for 3 seconds opens the basic settings.
buttons.function_en: A short press rinses a part load. Holding it for 3 seconds opens the basic settings.

buttons.function_native: Delays the start by up to 24 hours. Use minus and plus to set the hours.
buttons.function_en: Delays the start by up to 24 hours. Use minus and plus to set the hours.

buttons.function_native: Washes the lower basket harder, for dirty pots below and normal dishes on top. Uses more time and energy.
buttons.function_en: Washes the lower basket harder, for dirty pots below and normal dishes on top. Uses more time and energy.

buttons.function_native: Makes the programme shorter. Uses more water and energy.
buttons.function_en: Makes the programme shorter. Uses more water and energy.

buttons.function_native: A hotter, longer final rinse, for example for baby bottles and chopping boards.
buttons.function_en: A hotter, longer final rinse, for example for baby bottles and chopping boards.

buttons.function_native: Improves drying, for example for plastic items.
buttons.function_en: Improves drying, for example for plastic items.

buttons.function_native: Meaning not confirmed. It may be half load or machine care. Check the manual for your exact model.
buttons.function_en: Meaning not confirmed. It may be half load or machine care. Check the manual for your exact model.

buttons.function_native: A short press starts the programme. Holding it for 3 seconds cancels the programme.
buttons.function_en: A short press starts the programme. Holding it for 3 seconds cancels the programme.

steps.narration_native: First, scrape big bits of food into the bin. You don't need to rinse the plates. Put them in the baskets so nothing blocks the spray arms.
steps.narration_en: First, scrape big bits of food into the bin. You don't need to rinse the plates. Put them in the baskets so nothing blocks the spray arms.

steps.narration_native: Find the small detergent box on the inside of the door. Put in a tab or powder, then snap the lid shut.
steps.narration_en: Find the small detergent box on the inside of the door. Put in a tab or powder, then snap the lid shut.

steps.narration_native: Look at the black strip on the top edge of the door. Just right of the Siemens name is a small round button with a line in it. Press it to switch the dishwasher on.
steps.narration_en: Look at the black strip on the top edge of the door. Just right of the Siemens name is a small round button with a line in it. Press it to switch the dishwasher on.

steps.narration_native: Now find the button that says Eco, with 50 degrees under it. It's the third programme from the left. It's usually already chosen, but press it to be sure.
steps.narration_en: Now find the button that says Eco, with 50 degrees under it. It's the third programme from the left. It's usually already chosen, but press it to be sure.

steps.narration_native: Go to the right side of the strip and find the word Start. Press it once, quickly.
steps.narration_en: Go to the right side of the strip and find the word Start. Press it once, quickly.

steps.narration_native: Close the door within a few seconds. The wash begins once the door is shut.
steps.narration_en: Close the door within a few seconds. The wash begins once the door is shut.

steps.narration_native: When the wash is done, let the dishes cool for a little while. Empty the bottom basket first. That way water won't drip onto it from the top.
steps.narration_en: When the wash is done, let the dishes cool for a little while. Empty the bottom basket first. That way water won't drip onto it from the top.

tips.native: To add a forgotten dish, open the door carefully and press On/Off to pause. Then press On/Off again and close the door to carry on.
tips.en: To add a forgotten dish, open the door carefully and press On/Off to pause. Then press On/Off again and close the door to carry on.

tips.native: To cancel a wash, open the door, hold Start for about 3 to 4 seconds, then close the door. The machine pumps out the water in about a minute.
tips.en: To cancel a wash, open the door, hold Start for about 3 to 4 seconds, then close the door. The machine pumps out the water in about a minute.

tips.native: Tabs may not fully dissolve in the short Quick and 1-hour programmes. Use powder for short washes.
tips.en: Tabs may not fully dissolve in the short Quick and 1-hour programmes. Use powder for short washes.

tips.native: When the salt light comes on, refill the salt just before you start a wash. Use only dishwasher salt.
tips.en: When the salt light comes on, refill the salt just before you start a wash. Use only dishwasher salt.

tips.native: Use Eco 50° for everyday loads. varioSpeed Plus, intensiveZone and hygienePlus all use more energy.
tips.en: Use Eco 50° for everyday loads. varioSpeed Plus, intensiveZone and hygienePlus all use more energy.

tips.native: The model number is on a plate on the inner edge of the door. Use it to download the exact manual from the Siemens website.
tips.en: The model number is on a plate on the inner edge of the door. Use it to download the exact manual from the Siemens website.

warnings.native: Don't sit or stand on the open door, and close it after loading so nobody trips over it.
warnings.en: Don't sit or stand on the open door, and close it after loading so nobody trips over it.

warnings.native: Put knives in point-down or on the knife shelf.
warnings.en: Put knives in point-down or on the knife shelf.

warnings.native: If you open the door during a hot wash, leave it slightly open for a few minutes before you close it.
warnings.en: If you open the door during a hot wash, leave it slightly open for a few minutes before you close it.

warnings.native: Never open the casing or try to repair the machine or its water or power connections yourself. Contact Siemens official support or your landlord.
warnings.en: Never open the casing or try to repair the machine or its water or power connections yourself. Contact Siemens official support or your landlord.

closing_native: Well done! You've started an everyday wash on your Siemens dishwasher. Just remember: switch on, choose Eco, press Start, and close the door.
closing_en: Well done! You've started an everyday wash on your Siemens dishwasher. Just remember: switch on, choose Eco, press Start, and close the door.
